caption: Faaborg Harbour, Faaborg
composition: Harbour houses and the standalone bell tower · AI-generated artistic interpretation
description: From the harbour quay at Faaborg, wooden boats and low old houses sit on the water, and the town's standalone Klokketårn rises behind the roofs: yellow plaster, a red-tiled shoulder, a white octagonal lantern with clock faces, and a dark flared spire. The night is overcast, about 12.7°C, with wind near 17.3 km/h, and the quay is empty. The exact alignment of the tower from this quay was not surveyed.
